data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence of sites and steps (Wikipedia, timeanddate, Booking, Viator x2, OpenTable, Notes, Mail) with mostly correct parameters, but it omits the "review score 8+" hotel criterion, the "do not click Reserve/Book/time slot" constraints, and the first-result and first-evening-time rules. It also picks a time slot, ends with "send or discard" rather than always discarding, and leaves the activity and companion parameters inconsistent (activity_queries vs activity_1/2, friend_email vs companion name), so an automation built from it would be ambiguous and could take unwanted actions.
